title: Backprop through attention
hints: Walk backwards through out = w @ v: d_v = w^T @ d_out and d_w = d_out @ v^T. Transpose the last two axes with np.swapaxes so batch and head dims broadcast.
Softmax backward, row by row: d_s = w * (d_w - sum(d_w * w, axis=-1, keepdims=True)). Masked entries have w = 0, so they get d_s = 0 for free.
The scores were s = q @ k^T / sqrt(d_k), so d_q = d_s @ k / sqrt(d_k) and d_k = d_s^T @ q / sqrt(d_k).
